- **version** — 0.3.0

- **summary** — Interactively investigate this Mac’s network connections, listening services, and process security. Use for "netwatch", "analyze my network traffic", "investigate this process", unfamiliar destinations, changes over time, optional scoped packet capture, or stopping a network process the user selects. Default inspection reads local metadata; packet capture and process termination require specific user authorization. `skills/netwatch/skills/netwatch/SKILL.md:3`

## Setup

- **Claude Code:** Run on the local Mac with shell access to the bundled commands. `skills/netwatch/README.md:81`
- **Codex:** Allow the same local commands; a remote environment observes itself. `skills/netwatch/README.md:82`
- **Personal data:** Keep the existing ~/.netwatch/baseline.json or the user's selected path; no private data is bundled in the plugin. `skills/netwatch/README.md:83`
- macOS and Node 18+ for live collection; lsof and ps ship with macOS. nettop adds optional process counters. `skills/netwatch/README.md:85`
- Python 3.9+ for process inspection/termination (/usr/bin/python3 on macOS). `skills/netwatch/README.md:87`
- Packet capture uses the system tcpdump and needs local BPF access. Optional --sudo uses existing noninteractive sudo authorization only after the user approves the specific capture. `skills/netwatch/README.md:88`
- Offline report/parse/diff commands also work on other hosts. A remote agent observes its own machine. Linux process identity/signalling uses procfs/pidfd. `skills/netwatch/README.md:91`
- No npm dependencies. Existing ~/.netwatch/baseline.json remains supported; scripts resolve assets from their installed directory. `skills/netwatch/README.md:93`
- Requires Node >=18 (package.json engines). `skills/netwatch/skills/netwatch/package.json:34`
- Reads environment variable NETWATCH_UI_BROWSER. `skills/netwatch/skills/netwatch/scripts/tests/report-ui.test.mjs:11`

## Troubleshooting

- Every connection in the report is one the skill actually obs — The one rule. It is the reason this skill exists rather than a prompt; lose the line and the skill becomes a generic assistant with extr… `skills/netwatch/skills/netwatch/skill-invariants.json:9`
- Never claim a result you did not observe — Honesty about what was verified is the whole house contract. A skill that reports success it did not witness is worse than one that reports nothing. `skills/netwatch/skills/netwatch/skill-invariants.json:14`
- reads connections, not packet payloads — Default collection remains metadata only; optional scoped packet capture requires the user's concrete approval and stays local. `skills/netwatch/skills/netwatch/skill-invariants.json:19`
- An empty capture is never reported as .all clear — A snapshot taken while nothing was talking, or a capture command that silently failed, must read as 'I saw nothing', not as a clean bill of health.… `skills/netwatch/skills/netwatch/skill-invariants.json:24`
- A zero-match warning is never narrated into a success — accept --snapshot exits 0 on a new entry that matches nothing, by design — pre-seeding a range that is not live yet is legitimate. Exit 0 plus… `skills/netwatch/skills/netwatch/skill-invariants.json:29`
- Only the user chooses what to recognize, capture as packets, or terminate — Unknown or unsigned is never automatic permission to trust, capture, or stop. `skills/netwatch/skills/netwatch/skill-invariants.json:34`
